title: Light as field evidence
question: What can starlight honestly say about objects you will never visit?

intro.speaker: Ranger Wren
lines: Ridgeline to Dark Sky. The inherited log treats two bright white stars as twins because they look the same through the eyepiece.
I need that checked before the catalog treats a nickname as a fact. I'm on radio. Walk the basin. The light is the evidence.

afterTwins.speaker: Ranger Wren
lines: The eyepiece twins were not the same light. There's a reddish star the old notes call an ember — like a coal.
See what its light actually shows. Don't let fire-color folklore write the catalog.

idle: The catalog stays honest only if the light does. I'm still on radio.
